scope_outcomes.criterion: A positive citation requires Max Weber’s name or a specific citation to Weber in the reader’s text, with an anchored statement showing what the text does with that engagement.
scope_outcomes.basis: The article repeatedly names Weber, explicitly cites Weber 1946:126, and develops substantive claims about Weber’s treatment of values, nationalism, science, bureaucracy, charismatic leadership, and value pluralism.
limitations: This assessment covers only the supplied article, not Riley’s complete work or the thinker’s entire reception.
The article’s interpretations are sometimes developed through Riley’s engagement with Wendy Brown rather than through extended quotation from Weber.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
